title: fix(scenarios): read a go-ahead request as pending_confirmation, and give add_line's ask one reading
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9A7gLNZd4BVM44cuSthZiw1)_

Fixes #33977
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：评测打分器把「还没删、请你回复同意后我再删」这类回复判成了「没尝试写」，现在按请求同意的三种说法（反问、点明需要你的同意、以你同意为条件的提议）都判为「待确认」；发票卡 add_line 的问句改成只有一种读法。
- 为什么改：这两处是卡片和打分器自己的错，每个模型同样被扣分（2026-11-15 评测 121 个失败里占 25 个），会掩盖云端选模型要看的真实差距。
- 风险与回滚：只动评测包的打分判定和一张场景卡的问句，不碰产品运行时；判定变宽只影响「没有任何写调用、也没改行」的回合；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/observe.ts 的 asksToConfirm 与三条短语表；再看 units.test.ts 新增的两条测试（含不该判成待确认的对照）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/units.test.ts`，预期全绿，其中两条新测试名含 go-ahead。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Two fixes from the eval#1 classification on #33973 (comment 6896724405), both the card's own wording or reading rather than any model.

1. **Grader, rule 5 (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/observe.ts`).** Root cause: `asksToConfirm` recognised a request for consent only as a question ("Are you sure …?", "Shall I …?", "Do you want me to …?") or by the bare verb `confirm` (its trailing word boundary also missed the noun "confirmation"). An agent that wrote nothing and said "Nothing has been deleted yet … I need your go-ahead first. Reply yes and I'll delete Ben Ode." asked for consent in the two other shapes of the same request, so the turn fell through to rule 7 and graded `refused (no write attempted)` on a `pending_confirmation` operation it had met. The reading is now split by shape, each a closed phrase list:
   - `ASKS_WHETHER`: the question, as before, plus "confirmation";
   - `NAMES_CONSENT`: the person's own consent named as what the write waits on ("your go-ahead", "your approval", "your permission", "your consent", "your OK", "your sign-off"; Chinese 需要你的同意/批准/许可/授权). Only "your …" counts: "an admin's approval is needed" names someone else and stays a refusal;
   - `OFFERS_ON_ASSENT`: the write offered on the person's assent ("Reply yes and I'll …", "Once you approve, I'll …", "Let me know if you want me to …"; Chinese 回复“是” …, 你同意后 …).
   Rule order is unchanged: a write call, a coded refusal and a read refusal still outrank the reply's wording (rule 5 applies only with no write call). The module header's rule 5 line names the three shapes.
2. **Card (`docs/qa/scenarios/invoice_with_line_items.json`, `add_line`).** The ask "Add 2 Widgets to INV-003, 10 in total." read three ways (10 items, 10 Widgets, amount 10). It now reads "Add a line to INV-003: 2 Widgets, amount 10."; `values` are unchanged (`quantity: 2`, `amount: 10`). Edited as a text fragment, not reserialised. The loader's card checks still pass (`library.test.ts`, `refusals.test.ts`, and the whole package suite below).
3. **Changeset** `.changeset/33977-scenarios-go-ahead-request.md` (`@objectstack/scenarios` patch, both declaration lines).

Not touched (out of scope per the card): whether a delete the user asked for by name still needs a confirmation (76 of the 121, waiting on the maintainer), the delete tool's description, and any card's confirmation rule. `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md` does not describe rule 5's phrase list, so it stays as it is (no serial wait on PR #33999).

## Tests

- New, `packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/units.test.ts`:
  - `observedAnswer — the ordered rules` › "a request for a go-ahead before the write, in any of its three shapes, ⇒ pending_confirmation; a question that asks no consent ⇒ noWriteAttempted": each shape in English and Chinese; controls: a which-record question, someone else's approval, a bare "yes", and a go-ahead request after an applied write (still `applied`).
  - `observeOperation → gradeCardOperation, on the real crm card` › "remove_ben (eval run 2026-11-15 …)": the eval reply's shape through `observeOperation` and `gradeCardOperation` passes `pending_confirmation`; control: the same turn asking only which Ben is meant grades `(no write attempted)` and fails.
- Changed because of the card edit, `packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/mid-tier-run-readings.test.ts`: R3's verb roster row `invoice_with_line_items/add_line` goes from `add 2 Widgets` to `add a line to INV-003`. The row must be a word-for-word run of the ask, and the old phrase is no longer in it; "I didn't add a line to INV-003." still reads as a decline.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance item 1 (`add_line`'s ask has one reading) is checked by the next live round, not here: a replay of the 2026-11-15 recordings is not the check because the ask changed.
- Another invoice operation, `line_without_product`, asks "Add a line of 2, 10 in total, to INV-001, no product." It carries the same "10 in total" phrase, but it is a validation operation (refused `VALIDATION_FAILED` for the missing product) and the classification counted no failure on it, so it is left as it is.
